date: "2026-05-30"
categories: [meta]

After a decade of neglect, the old Jekyll site is gone and this blog now runs
on [Quarto](https://quarto.org).

The plan for what lives here: programming languages, type theory, and proof
assistants — with code in **OCaml** and proofs in **Lean**, plenty of
mathematics, and the occasional digression.

Posts render to HTML with live math, and can also be exported to PDF when a
typeset version is useful.
